priorityList: Cast Fire Breath on cooldown, always at Empower level 1
Cast Disintegrate as your Essence spender
Cast Living Flame as your filler
Cast Azure Strike if you have to cast whilst moving without any Hover charges
Cast Fire Breath at Rank 1 to apply its damage-over-time effect.
Cast Engulf on cooldown, ensuring Fire Breath is active on the target to trigger Enkindle.
Cast Eternity Surge at Rank 1 for single-target damage.
Cast Disintegrate to spend Essence Burst procs or to prevent capping Essence.
Cast Living Flame as a filler to generate Essence Burst procs.
Cast Azure Strike as a filler only if moving and Hover is unavailable.
